Medtronic è aumentato del 3,9 per cento in seguito ai risultati preliminari del suo scambio di MiniMed Group, secondo il Financial Times. Energy stocks led gains, rising 1.24 percent on average as oil climbed amid fighting in the Middle East and Ukraine, according to the Wall Street Journal. The WSJ also reported that energy stocks rose as global conflicts pushed up oil prices. Consumer Staples advanced 1.1 percent and Health Care gained 0.79 percent, while Technology and Information Technology sectors fell 1.56 and 1.47 percent respectively. The Dow Jones outperformed with a 0.46 percent average gain and 20 stocks rising against 10 falling, while the Nasdaq-100 declined 0.73 percent on average with 54 stocks down versus 47 up, underscoring weakness in growth-oriented names. Across the S&P 500, 321 stocks advanced and 179 declined.

Shopify climbed 4.9 percent on what Barron's characterized as an AI advantage, citing Wall Street's view of big upside in the stock. Medtronic rose 3.9 percent following preliminary results from its MiniMed Group exchange offer, per the Financial Times. Meta Platforms gained 3.38 percent after unveiling new Muse Wonder AI models, according to Barron's. Insulet Corporation advanced 3.35 percent on the announcement that Omnipod Discover is now available in the U.S., per the Financial Times. The session's losers were concentrated in technology and discretionary sectors. Ciena and Lumentum fell 9.95 and 9.78 percent respectively, with MarketWatch reporting that optical stocks were among the market's biggest losers. Coherent Corp. declined 7.87 percent with no tracked catalyst reported. Carvana dropped 6.62 percent per MarketWatch's coverage. Bloom Energy, Corning Inc., and Sandisk fell 6.5, 6.0, and 5.97 percent respectively, with no specific company news cited for the latter two. Astera Labs slid 5.29 percent; the Financial Times noted the company alongside Lumentum and Corning are demonstrating optical technology at the 2026 OCP Global Summit. Moderna declined 5.0 percent and Nebius Group fell 4.98 percent, both without tracked catalysts for the session.

markets_brief.prose_html: I bond indiani affrontano pressioni gemelle mentre la banca centrale difende la rupia e l'inflazione rimane elevata, comprimendo i rendimenti e i ritorni degli investitori. Nel frattempo, le azioni di Six Flags sono crollate dopo l'orario di chiusura in seguito a notizie di un incidente mortale su una montagna russa in uno dei suoi parchi in Georgia, con diversi feriti segnalati insieme alla vittima.
markets_brief.prose_html_en: Indian bond markets are under pressure from dual headwinds as the central bank defends the rupee while inflation remains elevated, squeezing yields and investor returns.
